label: B25-RX-OBSERVABILITY-NOFP-PROFILE

profile_contract.purpose: Fast first-board validation of the RXDBG PC=0, polling JTAG-UART and DDR diagnostic path.
profile_contract.architectural_limit: FP/NEON execution units are removed. Software must not execute FP/NEON; this profile is not final full-FP/P7 release closure.
profile_contract.provenance: This is a one-line derivative of the Gate-D-passed full-FP candidate 85992f53, not a claim that 85992f53 itself was no-FP.

validation.name: scope and parameter propagation
validation.detail: Exactly one tracked file and one added/removed line; board default 0 propagates board-to-SoC-to-core generate gate.

validation.name: no-FP static closure
checks: board skeleton lint consuming default A64_FP_SIMD=0

validation.name: vendor-timed JTAG-UART focused bridge and status
validation.result: PASS for Icarus and Verilator bridge plus status observability

validation.name: combined no-FP RXDBG full-SoC evidence
validation.result: PASS by exact input-equivalence reuse of T-20260920-005
validation.reason: The only T-008 change is the board top, which is absent from filelist_soc.f. Every SoC/boot source and both runners are byte-identical between T-005 source 8f25c8e1 and profile 05ea2488. T-005 already ran this exact SoC input with -GA64_FP_SIMD=0.

prior_result.coverage: startup/periodic/dynamic RXDBG, status, PONG, echo and exactly-once RX

resource_lock.local_attempt: Returned 75 because pypto-x verify-0052-ops-batch4 legitimately held local.
resource_lock.decision: No unlocked fallback and no duplicate heavy run: exact source/runner equivalence proves the existing T-005 no-FP full-SoC result covers the unchanged SoC input set.

harness_notes: Two initial board-lint wrapper attempts incorrectly exported VERILATOR_BIN to the Perl wrapper itself and recursed through --get-supported. Only task-owned process trees rooted at PIDs 199012 and 212944 were terminated.

The corrected run removed VERILATOR_BIN from the environment, selected the conda environment through PATH, and passed. The invalid logs are retained as task-local artifacts and are not acceptance evidence.
